\section{Causal interventions}
\label{app:causal}

\paragraph{Scope.} Causal interventions were run for the boolean role over 5 languages (C++, Java, JavaScript, PHP, Python), 3 models, and 3 intervention modes (ablate, patch, steer), giving 375 layer-wise measurements. They are reported here rather than in the main text because they were run within languages, not on the cross-lingual cells this paper is about, and so cannot support the paper's central claim.
